title: loam worktree land --json
description: What a land did, or with --dry-run, the plan. pr is the PR before the merge. methods, default_method, and checks are empty for a PR that is merged. The notes are left out when they do not apply.

worktree.description: The worktree, with the land that it records after the land.

methods.description: The merge methods that the repo allows.

default_method.description: The method that GitHub offers first. Empty for a PR that is merged.

method.description: The merge method of the land. Empty with a merge queue, and for a PR that is merged.

merge_queue.description: True when the base branch has a merge queue. The land adds the PR to the queue.

merged.description: True when GitHub says that the PR is merged.

merge_later.description: True when GitHub merges later: an auto merge, or a merge queue. Also true when Loam cannot see the merge yet (merge_note).

merge_note.description: Why Loam does not see the merge yet.

remote_branch_deleted.description: True when the land deleted the branch on GitHub, or GitHub had deleted it.

branch_deleted.description: True when the land deleted the local branch.
